supporting_reports.evidence: Moderate to severe clear-air turbulence over the mountains caught the cabin with carts not secured, and a flight attendant was struck by a cart.
Three passengers who were not wearing seat belts were injured.
Two flight attendants in the aft galley were injured.
A passenger standing in the aisle broke an ankle.
